title: Recent update on the development of HPV16 inhibitors for cervical cancer.
authors: Shoaib, Muhammad; Tariq, Amina; Liu, Yanchen; Yang, Mingwei; Qu, Lingbo; Yang, Longhua; Song, Jinshuai
one_liner_zh: 综述HPV16抑制剂及宫颈癌治疗，涉及E6蛋白靶点与AI诊断，但非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Persistent infection with human papillomavirus (HPV) can lead to cervical cancer (CC), which is the fourth most commonly diagnosed cancer in women globally. In this review, we have explained the HPV genome and the development of CC. Additionally, we summarized recently discovered small molecules that act as inhibitors of HPV-16. These molecules were identified through experimental and in-silico studies aimed at preventing or treating CC. HPV-16 and HPV-18 are the most common subtypes of HPV that cause CC globally. E6 oncoprotein of HPV-16 is considered the primary cause of CC progression. Therefore, E6 is the most focused targeted protein for developing specific and novel therapeutic inhibitors to treat HPV-related cancers. In recent years, various HPV inhibitors have been identified by means of experimental and in-silico studies. In addition, artificial intelligence-based medical diagnostic tools have grown more popular as they are capable of screening and diagnosing HPV-related cancer.
abstract_zh: 持续感染人乳头瘤病毒（HPV）可导致宫颈癌（CC），这是全球女性中第四大常见癌症。本综述中，我们阐述了HPV基因组及宫颈癌的发展过程。此外，我们总结了近期发现的小分子化合物，这些化合物作为HPV-16的抑制剂，通过实验和计算机模拟研究鉴定，旨在预防或治疗宫颈癌。HPV-16和HPV-18是全球导致宫颈癌最常见的HPV亚型。HPV-16的E6癌蛋白被认为是宫颈癌进展的主要原因。因此，E6是开发针对HPV相关癌症的特异性新型治疗抑制剂最受关注的靶蛋白。近年来，通过实验和计算机模拟研究已鉴定出多种HPV抑制剂。此外，基于人工智能的医学诊断工具因其能够筛查和诊断HPV相关癌症而日益普及。
